if: the document is a tax invoice required by section 31 and issued under rule 46 of the CGST Rules, 2017
no provision of rule 54 (tax invoice in special cases) displaces the particular
the supply is in the course of inter-State trade or commerce
then: for an inter-State supply, the tax invoice MUST carry the place of supply together with the name of the State
note: One mandatory particular of rule 46(n), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: place of supply along with the name of the State, in the case of a supply in the course of inter-State trade or commerce;
